# T014.fix1 — Migrate the frontend Vitest advisory chain

## Summary

On 2026-10-21 UTC with Node v24.21.0 and npm 11.19.0, migrated only the frontend test runner from Vitest 3.2.7 to the first patched Vitest 4.x release, 4.1.11. The npm-managed graph removes vulnerable tinypool 1.1.1 entirely (rather than introducing tinypool 2.1.2). All 38 offline tests pass: backend 15 and frontend 23, unchanged from before migration. No production behavior, Vite major, deployment, or ACS files changed.

## Changes (files and why)

- `frontend/package.json`: exact-pin Vitest 4.1.11, preserving the repository's exact runner pin convention.
- `package-lock.json`: regenerated by `npm install --save-dev --save-exact --workspace frontend vitest@4.1.11`; updates the owned Vitest 4 packages and their runner-only transitive graph, removes Vitest 3's tinypool/vite-node dependencies. No unrelated package versions changed.
- This note; no test or config edits were needed. Existing `frontend/vitest.config.ts` retains Node environment, `tests/**/*.test.ts` inclusion, and independent offline execution.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

- The [GitHub Vitest/mocker advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9) identifies 4.1.11 as first patched 4.x. [Tinypool worker-options advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3) first fixes 2.1.1, and [tinypool run-options advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr) first fixes 2.1.2. Verified all three GitHub advisory API records on 2026-10-21. Prior `npm explain tinypool` showed `frontend → vitest@3.2.7 → tinypool@1.1.1`; after clean install, `npm ls tinypool --all` returns an empty graph and neither audit target lists it.
- Registry `npm view vitest@4.1.11 ...` shows engines `^20 || ^22 || >=24`, peer/dependency Vite `^6 || ^7 || ^8`, and exact `@vitest/mocker@4.1.11`; `tinypool@2.1.2` allows Node `^20 || >=22`. Existing Vite 6.4.4 is within the runner's peer range, so no Vite major or peer override is needed. The [Node release schedule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/schedule.json) confirms Node 24 LTS through 2028-04-30.
- Runner processes developer/CI test workers, not a demonstrated request-exposed server; mocker arbitrary read requires exposure of a suitable development server/plugin. The tests exercise current offline frontend behavior. No `--force`, `--legacy-peer-deps`, audit suppression, or warning relaxation.

| Advisory | Severity | Package | From | To | Direct/transitive | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 | moderate | vitest / @vitest/mocker | 3.2.7 | 4.1.11 | direct frontend dev runner / transitive mocker | fixed | Official advisory; npm-managed lock; root scan omits both |
| GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3 | critical | tinypool | 1.1.1 | absent (first patched 2.1.1) | transitive via Vitest 3 | removed | Official advisory; `npm ls tinypool --all`; root scan omits it |
| GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr | critical | tinypool | 1.1.1 | absent (first patched 2.1.2) | transitive via Vitest 3 | removed | Official advisory; same lock and scan |

## Validation (commands and results)

Linux / Node v24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0. Pre-edit `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm test`: 15 backend + 23 frontend passed. After the last dependency edit, with `CI=true TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8`:

- `npm ci`: pass, 895 installed; npm reported remaining audit findings.
- `npm run build --if-present`: pass on Vite 6.4.4; existing three CSS optimizer warnings.
- `npm test`: **38 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped**, backend 15, frontend 23 (three test files).
- `npm run lint --if-present`: pass, zero errors and five pre-existing warnings.
- `npm exec --workspace frontend -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`: pass.
- `npm ci --prefix backend`: pass, standalone lock unchanged.
- `bash /shared/skills/dependency-vulnerability-remediation/scripts/scan-dependencies.sh --output-dir .modernization-scratch/scan .`: exit **2**, both targets scanned successfully; root 9 affected package names (0 critical, 8 high, 0 moderate, 1 low), backend 3 high. Previously root 12 names (2 critical, 8 high, 1 moderate, 1 low); the three removed names are Vitest, mocker, and tinypool. The names and severity totals are scanner aggregates, not distinct advisory counts. Scanner used npm 11.19.0; raw output is local-only.
- `git --no-pager diff --check`: pass. Diff and npm package graph show no Vite version change or unrelated package-version change.

## Follow-ups and risks

- Scanner exit 2 is **not clean**: CLI ZIP / devcert tmp / node-forge and development nodemon watcher advisories remain open (root nine affected names, backend three), as characterized in T013 and T013.fix1; no owner acceptance inferred. No new finding was introduced.
- No live dev server, Azure deployment, ACS integration, or production smoke test was performed; offline tests and build are the exercised behavior.
